message.abstract: <jats:p>Scaling relations limit catalyst performance in energy technologies. This tutorial introduces key concepts, analytical tools, and geometry-driven design strategies for creating next-generation electrocatalysts with enhanced activity and selectivity.</jats:p>
title: Twenty years after: scaling relations in oxygen electrocatalysis and beyond
